Sabre Benchmark Results

This report describes benchmark tests for The Sabre Narrative Planner version 0.8 by Stephen G. Ware.

20 planners were tested on 24 problems. Each test was repeated 10 times, and the order of actions was shuffled each time, for a total of 4800 tests.

Each search was limited to visiting 1000000 nodes. There was no limit on the number of nodes a search could generate. There was no time limit on a search.

Tests were run on the Ubuntu Java Runtime Environment version 21.0.7, running on the Linux operating system version 5.15.146.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2. The JRE used 429 GB 496 MB 729 KB 600 B of memory. It had a maximum memory of 429 GB 496 MB 729 KB 600 B.

Tests began on June 08, 2025 at 21:50:15 EDT and ended on June 12, 2025 at 14:46:19 EDT; they took 3 days 16 hours 56 minutes 3 seconds 855 milliseconds. Tests ran on 8 threads representing a total of 29 days 13 hours 58 minutes 50 seconds 676 milliseconds of computation time.

This report was automatically generated by the The Sabre Benchmark Tool version 1.0 by Stephen G. Ware.

It shows the number of elements in each problem, including the number of fluent, action, and trigger templates in the original problem and the number of ground fluents, actions, and triggers created from those templates after the problem was compiled and simplified. It gives the problem goal and limits on search. Problems are ranked from easiest to hardest based on how many times they were solved, average nodes visited to solve, average nodes generated to solve, and average time spent to solve.
